title: Messy sheet — abbreviations, crossed-out qty, out of stock, ambiguous item — 河内製作所
note: DEMO FIXTURE. Hand-authored example of what the vision step and the Nemotron agent produce for this sample. Tool calls are executed for real against the product master during playback; the transcription, the agent's choices and the reply text are pre-written.

sender.company: 株式会社 河内製作所 製造部

vision.free_text: 急ぎです！ 金曜朝イチ必着で / SUSが無ければ連絡ください

script.thought: 六ボル = 六角ボルト; M10-30 means M10×30. Quantity has no unit — the sales unit is 箱.
SB-1040 is out of stock. The customer wrote 'contact us if no SUS', so look for a stainless substitute and ask.
'ワッシャー M10' fits both flat and spring washers — ambiguous; flag for the clerk and ask the customer. Quantity 4 was struck out and rewritten as 6.

lines.note_ja: 六ボル＝六角ボルト。単位記載なし→箱で計上
lines.note_en: "Roku-boru" = hex bolt. No unit written → booked in boxes

lines.note_ja: M10×40は在庫切れ。同材質SUS304のM10×45(+5mm)を提案
lines.note_en: M10x40 is out of stock. Proposing same-material SUS304 M10x45 (+5mm)

lines.note_ja: 平/スプリングの区別なし。数量4を二重線で訂正→6
lines.note_en: Flat or spring washer not specified. Qty 4 struck out and corrected to 6

final.reply_ja:
いつも大変お世話になっております。大和金物でございます。
本日はご注文をいただき、誠にありがとうございます。下記の通り承りました。

【代替品のご相談】
ご注文の「ステンレス六角ボルト M10×40」は、あいにく現在在庫を切らしております。同じSUS304製の「ステンレス六角ボルト M10×45」(長さ+5mm)でしたら3箱すぐにご用意できますが、こちらでよろしいでしょうか。

【ご確認のお願い】
「ワッシャー M10」につきまして、平ワッシャーとスプリングワッシャーのどちらをご希望かお知らせいただけますでしょうか。数量は訂正後の6箱で承っております。

ご返信をいただけ次第、10月16日(金)朝着にて手配いたします。
お急ぎのところお手数をおかけいたしますが、何卒よろしくお願い申し上げます。
final.reply_en:
Thank you as always for your business. This is Yamato Kanamono.
Thank you very much for today's order. We have accepted it as listed below.

[Substitute proposal]
Unfortunately the stainless hex bolt M10x40 you ordered is currently out of stock. We can supply 3 boxes of the same SUS304 stainless hex bolt in M10x45 (5mm longer) right away — would that be acceptable?

[Request for confirmation]
For the "washer M10", could you let us know whether you need flat washers or spring washers? We have noted the corrected quantity of 6 boxes.

As soon as we hear back, we will arrange delivery for Friday morning, October 16.
We apologise for the trouble when you are in a hurry, and thank you for your understanding.
final.summary_en: Urgent Friday order from Kawachi Seisakusho: 2 lines confirmed, stainless M10x40 out of stock (M10x45 proposed), washer type unclear.
